status: Available style specification; final outputs require format-specific visual checks
source: Original interpretations of style names demonstrated in a user-supplied video; not recovered source code.
quality_checks: Readable text and measured contrast against rendered colors
No information communicated by color alone
Responsive layout with no horizontal overflow
Content remains readable without blur or animation

motion.reduced_motion: Remove decorative movement and nonessential transitions

name: Glassmorphism
summary: Depth with discipline. Translucent layers over a luminous atmosphere.
use_when: Use for product showcases, interactive learning hubs, and selected dashboard surfaces.
avoid_when: Avoid for dense tables over uncontrolled imagery or interfaces without a strong static fallback.
typography: System sans-serif with strong heading weights and readable body text.
layout: Layered surfaces, stable reading zones, controlled background accents.
surfaces: 20px corners, translucent dark surfaces, backdrop blur where supported, opaque fallback.
essential_traits: Readable opaque or nearly opaque text zones

adaptations.web: Use the tokens and live components; validate keyboard, mobile, contrast, and reduced motion.
adaptations.slides: Preserve hierarchy and palette with native editable shapes and text. Replace motion with static emphasis.
adaptations.documents: Use native headings, readable body text, restrained callouts, and solid reading surfaces.
adaptations.images: Describe composition and material cues; check text and layout separately. Do not claim pixel-exact token fidelity.

prompt: Apply Glassmorphism to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. System sans-serif with strong heading weights and readable body text. Layered surfaces, stable reading zones, controlled background accents. 20px corners, translucent dark surfaces, backdrop blur where supported, opaque fallback. Palette: background #111b40, surface #17264e, text #f3f5ff, muted #c3cde6, accent #c7f4ff, border #6b7aab. Essential traits: Layer separation and bounded transparency; Subtle luminous background; Readable opaque or nearly opaque text zones. Avoid: Transparency as the only boundary; Blur required to understand content; Animations behind reading text. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
